close_reason: All 32 review findings resolved: P0/P1 bugs fixed, P2 optimized, P3/P4 cleanup done
notes:
Maintainer risk: MEDIUM — Six findings. Round 1 fixes were clean; they introduced no new regressions. The main residual risks are: (1) COLLAPSE_THREADS_MAX_EMAILS is a hidden sizing invariant with no override hook; (2) 'placeholder'/'placeholder-blob' string sentinels are an undocumented coupling between handler and backend; (3) a test that nominally checks subsecond uniqueness never actually asserts; (4) KNOWN_FILTER_KEYS and SERVER_SET field lists require manual synchronization with their corresponding structs; (5) Email/set create silently discards envelope and body fields after validating them — a quiet spec gap; (6) MemoryBackend.query_changes ignores all filter/sort parameters, giving tests false confidence. None of these are exploitable from the wire, but items 2, 4, and 5 are the most likely to cause a future backend implementor to ship incorrect behavior.
Confidence: 75% chance of missed bug. Least confident flags: JMAP-1vdc.19 (JSON size vs RFC 5322 octet count — may be intentional approximation in MemoryBackend, not a correctness claim), JMAP-1vdc.11 (sub-second format — the .mmmZ variant is consistent within production code; the P0 bugs in .14/.18 are the real risk, .11 may be a symptom not a cause), JMAP-1vdc.29 (total=None when was_capped — RFC 8620 §5.5 is silent on whether total MUST be present when calculateTotal=true; the claim of client-visible silent failure is correct but severity depends on whether any real client inspects total). Uncertainty driven by: MemoryBackend is explicitly a test/reference backend so many 'bugs' may be acceptable simplifications; without a real backend implementation it is hard to distinguish intentional approximation from defect. Would raise confidence if: (1) a real production backend existed to compare semantics, (2) RFC 8621 §4.1.3 confirmed 'size' must be RFC 5322 octet count not JSON-serialized length, (3) integration test with a JMAP client that sends calculateTotal=true and checks the response field.
